## What each row measures

| Problem | Metric |
| --- | --- |
| **Darcy Flow** | Relative L2 error, 200 test samples |
| **Darcy Flow, Physics-Only** | Relative L2 error, trained on 1000 coefficient fields only |
| **Navier-Stokes 2D** | Relative L2 error, 200 test samples, 10-step rollout |
| **Lid-Driven Cavity** | RMSE as a percentage of the lid speed (1 m/s), one step ahead, Re 10,000 |
| **Pipe Flow** | Relative L2 error, 200 test samples, best of 3 seeds (the released checkpoint) |
| **Chip Cooling** | Test relative L2 error (not scored on the same points for every model) |
| **AirfRANS** | Volume MSE of the normalised fields, as a percentage, 200 test cases |
| **ShapeNetCar** | Relative L2 error of the volume velocity |
| **Car-CFD** | Relative L2 error of the surface pressure, 111 test cars |

Each model keeps the training recipe of its own paper, so a difference reflects the architecture and its recipe together. The [results summary](comparison.md) adds the figures, and the comparison page of each problem, linked from the [overview](index.md), has the details.
